evaluation_protocol.acceptance_condition: Finite BEC occupation and cooling direction pass; direct Pauli blocking passes; the complete neutron-spinor interval contains 720 degrees; all scale limitations and adverse controls are retained.
evaluation_protocol.falsification_condition: Reject if any source or row changes; finite bosons fail to accumulate in the measured ground state under cooling; Pauli blocking is absent in the declared identical-fermion regime; the complete spinor interval excludes 720 degrees; a trap-specific or response-specific value is relabelled as a universal formal scalar; an unfavorable row is omitted; or target data alter the sealed formal survivor.

frozen_relation.candidate_grammar: Generate the complete eight-axis product of the sealed spin-statistics law, finite BEC record, Pauli-blocking record, two-turn spinor interval, custody, full-row retention and formal/measurement separation.
frozen_relation.exact_domain: The admitted 256-form formal survivor; all three bound primary records; the complete BEC transition interval and direction rows; the complete Pauli rows; the complete spinor interval and return rows; and every custody, limitation and adverse-control row.
frozen_relation.statement: The finite Bose record measures ground-state occupation, its increase under cooling, and a sharp transition at (94 +/- 5)/100 of the declared trap scale, giving the exact interval [89,99]/100. The finite two-spin-state Fermi record directly observes Pauli blocking and a factor-two reduction in effective collision cross section. The sealed alternating-state return is two complete turns, corresponding to 720 degrees; the neutron-interferometry result is 704 +/- 38 degrees, giving [666,742], which contains 720. All three physical routes agree with their respective sealed structural distinctions. The BEC scale ratio and collision-response factor are retained as external apparatus-dependent measurements rather than relabelled universal Fold proof scalars.
